speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the cause of these symptoms, can you tell me your exact age and if you have noticed any bone pain specifically in your hips, knees, or ankles?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of fever, fatigue, easy bruising, and severe night pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia. I am requesting a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and a peripheral blood smear. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and Peripheral_Smear.
